why_ai: Booking, billing and check-in SaaS faces AI-native competitors; no licence or personal relationship protects it.
why_clarity: Bookings, payments and check-ins recur identically and succeed or fail visibly.
why_digital: Software sold to studio owners, fed by digital check-ins and delivered as a cloud service.

why_ai: Churn prediction from attendance data is a standard model any AI-native platform can ship.
why_clarity: Cancellation is a clear outcome, but whether an intervention saved a member takes months to see.
why_digital: Attendance and billing data in, retention alerts and outreach out through the platform.

why_ai: Constrained scheduling against recorded demand is a solved optimisation class.
why_clarity: Revenue per class hour is measurable, but grid changes need weeks to show effect.
why_digital: Booking history in, published class grid out, within studio software.

why_ai: Dunning optimisation is a mature, automated discipline with clear measurement.
why_clarity: A failed payment is either recovered or not, across thousands of identical cases.
why_digital: Card declines and retries are handled entirely by payment software.

why_ai: Scheduling density and cancellation handling are structured problems software solves without people.
why_clarity: Paid hours per available hour is an exact, frequently updated measure.
why_digital: Trainers work in person, but the product is booking and payment software.

why_ai: Schedule aggregation, sub matching and pay reconciliation are mechanical tasks.
why_clarity: A sub is filled and pay reconciles or not, every week for every instructor.
why_digital: Schedules and pay data across studios, delivered as an app instructors carry.

why_ai: Enrolment, progression tracking and parent messaging are structured and readily automated.
why_clarity: Enrolment and payment are clear, but progression rules vary by school and style.
why_digital: Currently paper and front-desk calls; software sold to owner-instructors through local relationships.

why_ai: Reconciling network check-ins against settlements is computable from records the studio holds.
why_clarity: Each visit either matches a settled payment or it does not.
why_digital: Digital check-ins and network settlement statements reconciled in software.

why_ai: Programme delivery and billing are systematised; AI coaching apps compete directly for the layer above.
why_clarity: Keeping clients on a programme is a relationship outcome, measured loosely through adherence.
why_digital: Programmes, messaging and billing run through coaching software.

why_ai: Adherence prediction over logged data is exactly what models do; AI coaches substitute directly.
why_clarity: Adherence relies on self-reported logs, so measured compliance may not match reality.
why_digital: The whole coaching relationship happens through apps, often across borders.

why_ai: Utilisation scheduling under variable durations and resources is a solved problem class.
why_clarity: Room and practitioner utilisation per available hour is directly measurable.
why_digital: Services are hands-on, but the product is booking and capacity software.
